summary: Frontend smoke and interaction testing completed across desktop and mobile. Core shopping flows passed; mobile homepage has horizontal overflow.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 390px viewport: document scrollWidth is 432px. The .hero-copy grid item expands beyond viewport (right edge 432px), likely due intrinsic min-width on the desktop grid item.

action_items: Set mobile hero grid children min-width: 0 or otherwise constrain .hero-copy so 390px layouts do not overflow horizontally.
critical_code_review_comments: The mobile breakpoint does not fully constrain the two-column hero grid item's intrinsic width, violating the no-horizontal-overflow requirement.
seed_data_creation: None; localStorage cart and wishlist state used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Age gate, 25-product catalogue, filters/sorting, search, wishlist, cart quantity/drawer, checkout demo, informational/legal routes, and mobile menu passed. Retest mobile overflow after CSS fix; browser console had no reported runtime errors.
rca of the issue: At 390px, .hero is display:grid and .hero-copy retains an intrinsic width of 412px (right edge 432px from 20px left), causing document scrollWidth 432px. Add min-width:0 to mobile grid children and verify long content/actions wrap within the viewport.
